This is another idea for a way to support Voat. As a developer myself, I would really, really love something like a weekly or bi-weekly hour-long podcast of /u/Atko and /u/Puttitout just talking about the challenges they've faced while developing Voat. This wouldn't take much effort to produce - a couple Skype accounts and some microphones - and would present several new avenues from which Voat could garner support. For instance:

  • There are many great podcast sponsorship programs from companies like Audible, Squarespace, etc
  • Patreon could be used to directly support the podcast / Voat
  • If the podcast was also uploaded to YouTube, ad revenue could be leveraged

One of the great things about Voat is that the community has already shown that we are hugely supportive of this site, and we want to donate / support it monetarily. This could be an easy way to make that happen, since the podcast would already have an audience in the thousands. It could also help to grow this site by exposing it to people who may not have found it otherwise. Lastly, it would help support Voat's idea of transparency.

This shouldn't be taken lightly - podcasts can make a ton of money if they're advertised properly (~$1k - $5k per month easily). I think the only drawback here is that both of them are already busy, but I feel like they could work it out since it could potentially mean helping to ease the financial burdens Voat presents.

Both @atko and myself are currently trying to budget more time for Voat dev, and if we can this would be a great idea. There are many things that come into play with a site like Voat from a dev perspective.
